objects.taxonomy_description: A medium-sized mammal characterized by a distinctive facial mask and ringed tail, distinguishable from similar carnivores like bears or badgers.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Facial_Markings: Presence of a prominent black mask around the eyes contrasting with lighter fur on the face.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Tail_Pattern: Tail exhibits distinct alternating dark and light rings along its length.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Ear_Shape: Ears are rounded, erect, and relatively small compared to the head size.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Body_Posture: Quadrupedal stance with a bushy tail and a compact, robust body structure.
